title: Plugin System: Add dependency management, lazy loading, and scaffolding CLI
body:
Implements structured plugin system with dependency resolution, lifecycle hooks, optimized lazy loading, and standardized scaffolding tooling. ## Plugin Registration (`@object-ui/core`) **`PluginSystem` class** - Manages plugin lifecycle with dependency validation: - Enforces load order based on declared dependencies - Executes `register()` callback with ComponentRegistry - Supports async `onLoad`/`onUnload` hooks - Prevents unloading plugins with active dependents ```typescript const pluginSystem = new PluginSystem(); await pluginSystem.loadPlugin({ name: 'chart-plugin', version: '1.0.0', dependencies: ['grid-plugin'], // Enforced at load time register: (registry) => { registry.register('chart', ChartComponent); }, onLoad: async () => { /* initialization */ } }, ComponentRegistry); ``` ## Lazy Loading (`@object-ui/react`) **`createLazyPlugin`** - Suspense-wrapped lazy loader with fallback support: ```typescript const ObjectGrid = createLazyPlugin( () => import('@object-ui/plugin-grid'), { fallback: } ); ``` ## Plugin Scaffolding (`@object-ui/create-plugin`) **CLI tool** generates complete plugin packages with: - ComponentRegistry integration boilerplate - Vite build + TypeScript config - Test setup - Input validation prevents path traversal (lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens only) ```bash pnpm create-plugin my-widget ``` Generates `packages/plugin-my-widget/` with implementation template, types, tests, and build configuration. ## Security - Path traversal prevention in CLI (validates against `../`, absolute paths) - Plugin name format enforcement (`^[a-z0-9-]+$`) - Error cleanup on registration failure
